anomalies.observed: Both alternative PWM selection jumpers are installed and shorted for each channel: R16 and R18 are both 0 Ω and connect J2/J9 pin 19 and pin 21 together through /NET0042, and R10 and R3 are both 0 Ω and connect J2/J9 pin 20 and pin 22 together through /NET0036.
anomalies.expected: The PWM selection jumpers are mutually exclusive: only one of pin 19/21 should be connected to the channel-1 PWM net, and only one of pin 20/22 should be connected to the channel-2 PWM net. The specification says the board modes are selected by populating different 0 Ω jumpers and that R9-R12 select which bus pin supplies each PWM channel.

anomalies.impact: Two M5Stack bus GPIO pins are shorted together on each PWM channel. If those pins are driven or used by a stacked module, this creates contention, prevents correct PWM pin selection, and can corrupt or damage the GPIO path.
